claims.statement: Punch Morris and Owen Meeker, quartered at the Wash Home, were to be trained by the trainer of Tom Allen.
claims.excerpt: Morris and Meeken are quartered at the Wash Home, and will be trained

notes: The sentence about Allen's trainer and Mace is garbled ("~ be the"), so the Mace reference is not used. The trainer is not named in the text, so the hint's Goldwin/Goulding is dropped.
